messages:
Asha: Quick sync  want to surface SLO alert rules in the console (thresholds + notify targets). Two routing modes proposed: per-tenant contacts OR policy-based routing (route->tier->contacts). Prefer per-tenant by default?
Rafael: per-tenant default makes sense for predictability. But product teams want a global "route policy" to avoid copy/paste across many tenants.
Jon: main risk = noisy tenants. We need notify_quota enforcement and a graceful soft-fallback (sampling + backoff). Otherwise we hit provider webhooks and end up throttled.
Asha: agreed. Proposal: API v2 returns `notify_config` + `quota_profile`. Example: 
```json
GET /api/v2/slo/123/notify -> {"notify_config": {"mode":"tenant|policy","targets":[...]} , "quota_profile": {"limit_per_hour":100, "burst":10}}
```
Rafael: that shape is good. But the console will need to show effective_target (after routing + fallback). UI concern: showing "effective" vs "configured" target.
Jon: telemetry needs: counters for `slo.notify.count{outcome=sent|suppressed|sampled|fallback}` and a gauge `slo.notify.quota_remaining`. Also tag by tenant_id, route_id, and policy_id.
ops-bot: note: PR #1221 opened with API v2 schema + metrics: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1221
Asha: rollout plan: feature-flag notify_console_v2, canary to 10% tenants, monitor for 48h. Canary checks: suppression-rate < 25% and no webhook 429s.
Rafael: add dashboard widget: "Notify health" — stacked bars for sent/suppressed/sampled per tenant. Also a heatmap for suppression-rate.
Jon: action items: (1) add quota enforcement in notify service (soft-limit with sampling), (2) expose /internal/notify/preview endpoint for admins (dry-run), (3) emit metric `slo.notify.fallback` when fallback used.
Asha: UX: console should surface a red badge when tenant is at 0% quota and a CTA to raise quota or mute temporarily. Also allow simulated preview to a test webhook.
Rafael: security note  preview payloads must scrub tokens and be logged only to secure audit trail for 7d.
ops-bot: canary toggle set by experiment service: experiments.toggle("notify_console_v2", enabled_for=10%)
Jon: do we want auto-fallback to global_policy when tenant contacts broken? I vote yes, but log audit and increment fallback metric.
Asha: agreed. Fallback order: tenant_contacts -> policy_contacts -> global_webhook -> noop (audit). Each fallback increments `slo.notify.fallback` with reason tag.
Rafael: migration: compat layer for current notify-preview UI to read `notify_config` v2. Plan: show legacy preview until flag off.
Asha: volunteers: Rafael will own UI changes, Jon owns notify service quota code and metrics, I'll write RFC + rollout checklist. Ops-bot will run the canary toggle and monitor alerts.
Rafael: FYI I'll add a tiny inline help tooltip: "Effective target may differ from configured target due to routing/fallbacks".
Jon: will add an alert: `sum(slo_notify_count{outcome="fallback"}) by (tenant) > 5` -> page.
Asha: perfect. Landing PRs this week. Thanks all. :rocket:
